_comment: Default scaffold for a new GROMACS CG task's scripts/task_config.json. Written once by the quick-create channel (backend/services/task-dir.js scaffoldTaskConfig, called from POST /api/tasks/create) and never overwritten afterwards, so hand edits here are permanent. Fields marked FILL-IN are placeholders the quick-create channel cannot know and a human must set. See backend/tasktype/gromacs_cg/lib/task_config.py for how every field is consumed, and docs/task-creation.md for the full workflow.
remoteDir: FILL-IN: absolute remote path where this task's sample dirs live, e.g. /home/<user>/CG_2KY10/<name>

defaults.protein: FILL-IN: short protein/construct description shown on the Dashboard, e.g. '2KY10 SELP CG network (Martini 3.0.0)'

sampleGlobs: FILL-IN: remote glob(s) for this task's per-sample output dirs, relative to remoteDir, e.g. 'shear/*'

slurm.user: FILL-IN: remote SLURM username (for scancel on stop)
slurm.jobPrefix: FILL-IN: SLURM job name prefix used by this task's sbatch scripts
